test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Harry asked me if I wanted to see magic.

options.text: Harry said, “Do you want to see magic?”
Harry said to me, “If you want to see magic?”
Harry said to me, “Do you want to see magic?”
Harry said, “If you want to see magic?”

solution:
The correct answer is "**Harry said to me, “Do you want to see magic**?” 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The option that expresses the given sentence in **direct speech** is:

 
 
• **Harry said to me, "Do you want to see magic?"**
 
 
 
• The given sentence is in **indirect speech**, where Harry's question is **reported** rather than quoted **directly**.
 
• To convert **indirect speech to direct speech:**
 
 
• the **reported speech** is enclosed in quotation marks and
 
• the **reporting verb "asked**" is replaced with "**said**".
 
• The **pronouns** also need to be **changed to reflect the speaker and listener**.
 
 

Thus, ***option 3*** is the correct answer.
